description: This Python source file implements a custom security guardrail class ('PillarGuardrail') for the LiteLLM framework. The class provides mechanisms to perform security scans on LLM requests and responses using the Pillar Security API. It includes methods for pre-call, during-call, and post-call hooks, handling API communication, error handling, response processing, and request metadata management.

classes.name: PillarGuardrail
classes.description: A custom guardrail class that performs security scanning via the Pillar API for LiteLLM requests and responses, with support for configurable actions on detection, fallback policies, and detailed request/response processing.
